integrity: The complex is reconstructed independently from the published six facet-orbit representatives and affine action. Exact mod-two boundary reduction checks all \(182\) missing tetrahedra and every affine carrier orbit. Integral identification uses the published \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z/2\) and \(H_1=0\) through the universal coefficient theorem. Older exact-object literature was found with only year/month-resolved publication metadata; the recorded day is the earliest day-resolved exact-presentation source inspected, and no earlier day was invented.
scientific_limitations: The orbit decomposition is for the published affine subgroup \(13{:}3\) and for minimum vertex support only. It does not assert the full automorphism group or classify larger-support torsion representatives.
title: Six affine orbits of minimum-support torsion spheres in the thirteen-vertex Wu manifold
